items.title: Jack Sheldon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: So I got to be with Zoot Sims a lot, which that was always good.

ctx.x: Yeah, he seemed to have that ability to directly connect what was coming out of here through his instrument.
